questions.question: Explain one benefit to a business of operating in a niche market. (4 marks)
The chilled-juice market was worth $32 million last year and $40 million this year. Zuri Juice sold $6 million this year. Calculate Zuri's market share and the market's growth rate. (4 marks)
Analyse one way in which the growth of online retailing has affected competition in a market you have studied. (6 marks)

Zuri Juice surveyed 600 shoppers and 18% said they would buy a high-juice bottle weekly at $1.20. Its target market holds 500,000 shoppers. Discuss the usefulness of this research in estimating likely demand. (8 marks)
Zuri Juice has one month and a small budget before it decides whether to launch a new bottle. Assess the most appropriate method of primary research for it to use. (10 marks)
Explain one reason why a business might use secondary research before commissioning primary research. (4 marks)

Construct a market map for the chilled-juice market using price and juice content as the two axes, plotting Tamu ($0.70, 15%), Mkali ($0.85, 35%), Zuri ($1.20, 45%), Safi ($1.60, 40%) and Halo ($1.90, 85%), and mark one gap. (4 marks)

Zuri Juice has mapped the chilled-juice market on price against juice content and found an empty position at about 80% juice for $1.20. Discuss the usefulness of that market map in deciding whether to launch there. (8 marks)
Explain one way in which a business could add value to a product. (4 marks)
Assess whether branding is the most effective way for a small food or drink business to add value. (10 marks)
Evaluate whether adding value or charging a lower price is the better way for a business to build a competitive advantage. (20 marks)
